scope: Selected shipped first-party native XML layouts, native component code and bound resource dependencies; static evidence only
limitations: Day/night resolution here means base values and values-night only. Other qualifiers are preserved as qualifiedDefinitions and need Android configuration selection.

A declared XML value is not proof of the currently visible layout; code may replace it. Current MineFragmentV4/SportTabV4Fragment are YRN containers; similarly named native XML is legacy/compatibility evidence only.
dp to CSS px and sp to CSS px are reconstruction conventions, not physical pixel equivalence. Respect density, Android fontScale, system insets and font fallback.
CSS border-radius does not reproduce MIUI smooth adaptive corners exactly.
Screen-specific alpha, accessibility text scale, code animation and data-driven visibility need runtime validation.

states.pressed: same color and radius as default

componentContracts.inference: 30dp icon plus 15dp top/bottom margins produces a 60dp content block when the icon participates; this is not proof of a universal fixed row height.

setViewPadding forwards raw integer values to setPadding; calling context determines pixels
